name: kube-coder-dashboard
_comment_esbuild: Lifts vite 6's esbuild (it requests ^0.25.0) to 0.28.2, the version Renovate moved this pin to in #631. Originally added so yarn hoisting could not mix vitest 2's bundled-vite-5 esbuild 0.21.5 with vite 6's 0.25.x; vitest 4 no longer bundles vite, so vite is now the only esbuild consumer. Dropping the pin would downgrade the build to esbuild 0.25.x.
_comment_brace_expansion: GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (uncatchable OOM) affects every brace-expansion <=5.0.7 with no backported fix, so all instances must reach 5.0.8. That requires minimatch >=10 (older majors expect the pre-5.x default-function export). Only test-exclude/glob (vitest coverage) consume minimatch here; both verified working on 10.2.5. Remove both pins once dependents require brace-expansion ^5.0.8 on their own.
_comment_vite: GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm (launch-editor existence-check bypass, Windows command injection) affects every vite <=6.4.3 with fixes only on >=6.4.4, so the copies vitest and @vitest/mocker resolve must be patched too. Vitest 4 accepts vite ^6 || ^7 || ^8, so without this resolution it would pull a second, newer major alongside the app's vite 6; the pin keeps a single patched vite 6 (now 6.4.5) for both. Remove once the app moves off vite 6 or vitest requires a patched vite 6 itself.
